title: The Complete Story of Noah (Genesis 5-9) KJV
description:
The Complete Story of Noah, read from the King James Version: Enoch who walked with God (Genesis 5:21-24), the corruption of the earth and the building of the ark (Genesis 6), the flood begins (Genesis 7), and the flood ends with the raven, the dove, the altar and the rainbow covenant (Genesis 8:1-9:17). Five stories in one sitting, with the Keeper's honest questions at the open and the close.

Chapters
0:00 The Keeper's question
0:09 Enoch Walked With God
1:19 God Sees the Earth Corrupt
4:05 Noah Builds the Ark
6:53 The Flood Begins
9:39 The Flood Ends: The Raven, the Dove and the Rainbow
18:01 The Keeper's honest question

Scripture quotations: King James Version (public domain). The Keeper's commentary is the channel's own interpretation, spoken apart from the scripture.
Original narration and owned music by HeroVerse. Narration voices are AI-generated. Visuals are AI-generated or animated illustrations: an artistic Bible-story reconstruction, not footage of historical events.

Subscribe for the whole Bible, one story at a time.

first_comment: Which moment in Noah's story would you have found hardest to trust: the years of building, the seven days of waiting, or the months afloat with no land in sight? I read it from the King James Version; the notes between the scenes are the Keeper's own.
